layout.arrangement: Title slide. A white outer canvas surrounds a large light-gray slide panel with a thin dark-red border. The panel is inset from the frame on the left (~4%), top (~7%), and right (~4%); its bottom edge is clipped by the frame (it runs off the bottom). All text is center-aligned in a vertical stack in the middle of the panel: main title 'Transformers', subtitle 'Part I' directly beneath it, and the date 'Aug. 2020' beneath that. A small pale-yellow elliptical slide-number badge with a purple outline sits in the top-right corner inside the panel. A tiny gray '+' crosshair artifact appears just left of center, below the date.

Everything else is empty light-gray space.

imagery: No photos, icons, or illustrations. The only graphic shapes are the pale-yellow/purple slide-number badge (with numeral '2') and the small gray '+' crosshair artifact.
typography_notes: Entirely sans-serif (Arial/Helvetica-like), all center-aligned, all in red #C00000 except the badge numeral. Title 'Transformers': very large, bold (~66pt estimate). 'Part I': bold, ~45-50% of the title size (~32pt estimate). 'Aug. 2020': bold italic, slightly smaller than 'Part I' (~26pt estimate). No all-caps styling. Badge numeral '2': small, regular weight, near-black #333333 (~12pt estimate). All absolute point sizes are reconstruction estimates derived from these relative proportions.
animation_state: No build state visible; static section/title slide with all elements shown simultaneously.
recreation_brief: 1. Set the slide background to solid white #FFFFFF (no gradients or textures). 2. Draw the slide panel rectangle: left edge at 4% of slide width, right edge at 96% of slide width, top edge at 7% of slide height, bottom edge extended past the slide boundary so it bleeds off the bottom (the source frame clips it); fill #E9E9E7, outline #C00000 at ~1.5pt (~2px), no shadow; send it behind all other elements. 3. Title: text box horizontally centered with vertical center at ~42% of slide height; text 'Transformers', Arial Bold ~66pt, color #C00000, center-aligned. 4. Subtitle: text box horizontally centered at ~50%-58% of slide height directly below the title; text 'Part I', Arial Bold ~32pt, color #C00000, center-aligned. 5. Date: text box horizontally centered at ~60%-66% of slide height directly below the subtitle; text 'Aug. 2020', Arial Bold Italic ~26pt, color #C00000, center-aligned. 6. Slide-number badge: ellipse ~0.5in in diameter centered at ~92% slide width and ~13% slide height (top-right, inside the panel); fill #FDFD96, outline #6A5ACD at ~1.5pt; overlay centered text '2', Arial Regular ~12pt, color #333333. 7. Optional artifact: text box containing a single '+' character, Arial ~10-12pt, color #999999, centered at ~40% slide width and ~68% slide height (just left of center, below the date); the source flags this as a likely cursor/alignment artifact, so omit it if only intentional content should be reproduced. 8. Add nothing else: no bullets, charts, images, icons, or additional text; the remaining panel area stays empty light gray.

fixes_applied: Reconstructed the empty verbatim_text.bullets with the three on-slide text lines 'Transformers', 'Part I', 'Aug. 2020' (derived from slide_title, subtitle_or_header, and the Date line region) so the required field is non-empty and verbatim_text alone captures all slide text.

Moved 'Aug. 2020' from verbatim_text.labels to verbatim_text.bullets (it is a standalone date line, not a label on a visual element); labels now contain only the badge numeral '2' and the '+' crosshair mark.

Fixed the layout.arrangement contradiction ('inset on all sides' vs 'clipped at the bottom edge'): the panel is inset on the left (~4%), top (~7%), and right (~4%) only, with the bottom edge clipped by the frame.

Harmonized the 'Aug. 2020' font size in recreation_brief from ~20pt to ~26pt to match typography_notes ('slightly smaller than Part I'); the size ladder is now 66pt > 32pt > 26pt, consistent with the hierarchy note ('smaller still').
Standardized the badge numeral color to #333333 everywhere (visual_elements said 'black numeral' while listing #333333).
Harmonized the panel border weight between '~2px' (visual_elements) and '~2pt' (brief) to ~1.5pt (~2px).

Replaced vague descriptors with concrete specs: 'tiny/small +' becomes a '+' text mark ~10-12pt in #999999 at ~40%/68%; 'roughly half its size' becomes ~45-50% (32pt vs 66pt); the 'small ellipse' badge becomes ~0.5in diameter at ~92%/13%.
Added badge_numeral_text (#333333) and artifact_mark (#999999) to the colors object so every colored element is covered.
Rewrote recreation_brief as an ordered 8-step checklist that places exactly one element per step with exact text, position, hex color, shape, and font specs.
uncertain_items: The '+' crosshair is flagged in the source as 'likely a cursor or alignment-guide artifact, not intentional content'; it is preserved as optional step 7, and the reproducer must decide whether to include it.
All absolute point sizes (66/32/26/12pt) and the badge diameter (~0.5in) are estimates derived from relative-size descriptions; exact values are not verifiable from the JSON.
The badge is described as both 'circular' (arrangement) and 'ellipse' (regions/visual_elements); it is treated as a near-circular ellipse.
The panel bottom is described as '~98% (cut off by frame)' in regions and 'running off the bottom' in visual_elements; the brief assumes the panel bleeds off the bottom edge.
